integrity: The proof is self-contained once the published ball-gradient direction, nonvanishing, integrability, and translation-invariance facts are supplied. No numerical experiment or unverified asymptotic step is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite positive nested-ball towers and the endpoint \(p=1\). It gives no quantitative stability bound in the center offsets and makes no claim for general nonnested step functions, infinite towers, or fixed \(p>1\).
title: Rigidity of the endpoint fractional-gradient deficit for nested ball towers
